items.why: Follow-through after Friday's Q3 deliveries beat of 486,532 vehicles, plus IMC Logistics ordering 50 Tesla Semis today. Broader tech strength helped.
Hit an all-time high as its market cap closes in on $6 trillion, per Yahoo Finance. Barron's notes Nvidia and Intel are now leading the market dynamic.
Saudi Aramco cut November Arab Light pricing to Asia as Middle East crude exports recovered, while G7 nations planned strategic stockpile releases, per the WSJ.
Extending its AI-driven rally on reports of a custom "Iris" AI chip entering manufacturing, expanded computing capacity, and a new AI model. It crossed its 200-day moving average.

market_note: S&P and Nasdaq futures are green (+0.67% and +0.85%); Nasdaq closed at a record high.
summary: The Nasdaq hit a record high as mega-cap tech led the way despite bond yields reaching fresh highs. Tesla and Nvidia paced the gainers while oil slid on recovering Middle East supply.
